entries.heading: SUSTAINABLE AGRICULTURE TECHNOLOGY DEVELOPMENT AND TRANSFER PROGRAM
ancestors: TITLE VII—RESEARCH, EXTENSION, AND RELATED MATTERS
Subtitle B—Food, Agriculture, Conservation, and Trade Act of 1990
entries.text:
SEC. 7203. SUSTAINABLE AGRICULTURE TECHNOLOGY DEVELOPMENT AND 
                          TRANSFER PROGRAM.

    Section 1628(f)(2) of the Food, Agriculture, Conservation, and Trade 
Act of 1990 (7 U.S.C. 5831(f)(2)) is amended by striking ``2018'' and 
inserting ``2023''.
